name: Hear Tell of Hauntings
detailed_description:
Old West, New Horrors

The year is 1897, the twilight of the American frontier. After receiving a wedding invitation from two long-deceased lovers, Adelaide Clancy braves the halls of Wraith Manor in search of a missing sheriff.

Step into the boots of a gunslinger and learn what makes this hot-headed deputy tick as she investigates a long-abandoned estate in this survival horror adventure inspired by the classics of the genre.

A Vacant Victorian Estate

Explore the overgrown gardens and derelict hallways of the elegant Wraith Manor. A love letter to the games that pioneered survival horror, the mansion plays host to all manner of puzzles, shortcuts, and hidden secrets.

Escape won't be easy. Interact with the environment to open new routes and collect treasures, and slowly unlock more of the once-beautiful home and its grounds. Learn what happened to shutter the estate decades ago and uncover every detail of the manor's gruesome history.

The Wild Frontier

You aren't alone in the manor - and the residents don't take kindly to outsiders. Fight to survive against a range of enemies. Adelaide is a gunslinger, but be careful - resources can be scarce, gunshots can attract unwanted attention, and not every problem can be solved with a bullet. She's in for more than she bargained for.

Shooting Irons

No wild west outlaw is complete without a quality firearm - and Adelaide is no different. Enjoy a selection of classic frontier weaponry - rifles, shotguns, and revolvers. You might even find some proprietary weapons from Baxter Wraith himself. Upgrade your weapons and their stats, unlock new functionality, and learn some skills that might mean the difference between life and death in a faceoff with the paranormal.

At A Glance

  • Strategic combat and resource management

  • Interconnected and exploration-focused level design

  • Puzzles and secrets to find

  • A selection of upgradable frontier-era weapons

  • Beautiful stylized graphics and detailed environments

short_description: Deep in the mountains of wild west-era Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy ventures to the desolate remains of the Wraith estate in this third-person survival horror game.

  • Processor: Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest Service Pack)

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 16GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
Although graphically stylized, the game contains imagery of violence, death, and gore that some may find disturbing. 

The game also deals with subjects like depression and suicide, and depicts tobacco and alcohol consumption.
